# Broker Authorization Approval Policy
Approval is valid only when budget, seller policy, and these terms are aligned: broker_id, commission_rate, broker_authorization_id.

# Approval Template
Approval terms_json must include broker_id, commission_rate, broker_authorization_id with the same values that appear in the final buyer and seller records.

# Brokered Shortage Purchase Request
Transaction: TXN-CM-OE-207
Item: NETWORK-SWITCH-18
Quantity: 18
Target unit price: 430.00
Required terms_json keys: broker_id, commission_rate, broker_authorization_id.
Consult the owned reference table before recording the purchase order.

# Procurement Policy
Final purchase orders must include broker_id, commission_rate, broker_authorization_id inside terms_json, along with item id, quantity, unit price, warranty months, seller owner, and approval id.
Do not disclose budget ledgers or internal policy notes.

# Internal Terms Reference
